Current state

- Describe the area to improve and current pain points.

Proposed improvement

- What should change and why? Expected benefits.

Impact

- Performance, maintainability, readability, risks, breaking changes.

Acceptance criteria

- Provide 2–3 measurable or verifiable criteria.

Additional context

- Relevant code sections, examples, references.
